page.title: Sahyog Drive
page.intro: Every drive whose contributions have finished, with the number of contributions confirmed as received. Drives whose contributions have finished appear under Closed; those whose every contribution has been checked against bank records appear under Verified. Drives that are still Live are not listed here.

section.archive.title: Verified drives
